create_SubjectParser: create a SubjectParser instance to parse ZJU dataset for a given subject ID and root path
load_image: load an image from a specific frame and camera using the SubjectParser load_image method
load_mask: load a segmentation mask or trimap for a frame and camera from the ZJU dataset
load_meta_data: load SMPL meta data including vertices, joints, and transforms for specified frame IDs
parse_camera: parse camera intrinsics, extrinsics, and distortion coefficients from ZJU dataset annotations
